evals.prompt: 幫我截目前桌面畫面，存成 PNG，並回報檔案路徑與畫面是否空白。
evals.expected_output: Uses the bundled Windows capture script or an equivalent system screenshot route, saves a PNG, and reports path plus basic visual validation.

evals.prompt: 針對目前 localhost runtime app 做截圖驗證，確認畫面不是 blank，並指出 UI 有沒有重疊或缺圖。
evals.expected_output: Chooses a browser/runtime screenshot path before desktop capture, captures or inspects the page, and reports visual findings.

evals.prompt: 我有一個 Figma node URL，幫我截那個 node 的畫面，不要截整個桌面。
evals.expected_output: Uses the Figma screenshot tool by extracting file key and node id instead of using the Windows desktop fallback.
